text.p: - After only 10 full working days in the Kremlin President Boris Yeltsin goes back to hospital.
- The high-standard treatment that President Yeltsin must be receiving at the elite Central Clinical Hospital in Moscow makes it almost certain his recovery will be quick and complete.
- The news about President Yeltsin's new sick-leave has failed to shake foreign capitals.
- The new $10 border tax is set to make Russian families divided after the break-up of the Soviet Union worse off.
- President Yeltsin is in hospital once again and his doctors are once again confident everything will be all right.
- Turkey says chances are it may have to occupy Cyprus.
- Both Russia and its president are sick and Russia may be even worse off than its ailing leader.
- Russian troops withdraw from Chechnya, leaving behind hundreds of missing in action.
- President Yeltsin's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais and deputy secretary of the Security Council Boris Berezovsky cancel their trip to the US on the news of Boris Yeltsin's pneumonia leave.
